column2: The vendor declares an ST77916 driver IC; esp_lcd_sh8601 is the software component this project binds.
The panel is a 360x360 round IPS LCD declaring 262K colours.
RGB888 is a 24-bit colour pixel format; the panel itself still declares 262K colours.
Whether the encoder shaft has a push switch is unconfirmed on the owned unit.
Tap the zone name to open the zone picker.
The vendor declares the CST816 family; the fitted marking is unverified.
The vendor-linked datasheet is for the CST816D part.
Backlight on GPIO 47, initial duty CONFIG_RK_BACKLIGHT_NORMAL (100/255).
The vendor declares the SoC as ESP32-S3R8 with 8 MB PSRAM.
Automatic display dimming and sleep are configurable from the knob settings.
This firmware reads rotation only; it reads no shaft switch on any GPIO.
The firmware drives an LEDC PWM backlight and can dim it on idle.
Sitronix publishes the ST77916 datasheet the vendor declaration points at.
LVGL is configured for 16-bit colour, so each pixel is two bytes on the wire.
